prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent raster sprite sheet for Rainbow Patrol falling aircraft. Input image is the project's existing original plane atlas: preserve the TOP LEFT cream-and-red player biplane identity and TOP SECOND olive/green enemy biplane identity, cloth wings, rigging, roundels, tail and wooden propeller. Output exactly 1536x1024 transparent PNG, 4 columns x 2 rows, equal 384x512 cells, full aircraft centered in each with large transparent gutters and CONSISTENT physical scale. TOP ROW: four sequential longitudinal AXIAL BARREL ROLL poses of the cream/red biplane, always nose pointing RIGHT, horizontal flight direction. Frame 0 upright side profile. Frame 1 rolled 90 degrees about its nose-to-tail axis, wings presented vertically. Frame 2 inverted upside-down side profile. Frame 3 rolled 270 degrees about its nose-to-tail axis, opposite wing presentation. BOTTOM ROW: the exact same four axial roll views for the olive green enemy biplane. These are rolling around the fuselage, not rotating nose-up/nose-down in the image plane. Airframe slightly damaged with a few scorched dark patches but still recognizable, no fire or smoke baked in (runtime adds it). Beautiful detailed handpainted Amiga adventure sprites matching the reference, not geometric block art or vector. No scenery, labels, UI, falling people or motion streaks. Actual transparent alpha background; each whole pose stays inside its cell. Same airframe length across all 8 poses.
